rule_evidence.meaning: Four-digit public/listed/OTC stock codes; preferred and other instruments have separate coding conventions.
Previously issued ETF/TDR/closed-end fund codes may remain four digits; four digits alone never confirm ordinary stock.

classification_policy: Keep the accepted confirmed subset plus separately identified ordinary_stock_rule_candidate exploration pool; do not infer CFI or original announcement timestamps.
scope_limit: Historical quote-present pool, not a complete suspended-security membership master. Frozen retrospective ISIN evidence is not contemporaneous classification.
